text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"uses \"The text states...\" evidence with explanation","quality":"reasoned elaboration","description":"The essay does more than quote the source; it explains how each piece of evidence supports its claim."},{"evidence":"\"This would benefit everyone in so many ways\" ... \"massive drop in pollution\"","quality":"development","description":"The essay develops its main ideas with more specific consequences and implications rather than simply asserting them."},{"evidence":"\"A counter argument... is the law\"","quality":"acknowledgment of counterargument","description":"The essay recognizes an opposing concern and addresses it instead of arguing in only one direction."},{"evidence":"clear paragraphing with intro, body, and conclusion","quality":"organization","description":"The essay is more clearly structured into a full argument with a beginning, supporting points, and a closing."},{"evidence":"\"We need to let the future in because it will drive us to greatness\"","quality":"conclusion","description":"The essay ends with a more purposeful concluding statement that restates the position and leaves a final impression."}]}
